scope:
Fresh injected/OS DNS IDs per exchange, with typed failure and abort cleanup.

Live random IDs may repeat. Checks assert request/reply matching and source
call counts, never sample uniqueness or cryptographic quality.
limitations: Built using the isolated telescope-cache/GC experiment; unchanged compiler build hit the known 16 GiB guard. No compiler patch installed.
Integration tests, not formal proofs. Resolver configuration/search wiring and EDNS negotiation/fallback remain unfinished.
